Q6111.reason: The littering ordinance is content-neutral and serves a clean-parks interest unrelated to suppressing expression, so it can apply under O'Brien even though the dumping was expressive.

Q8473.reason: Hektoen enteric agar selects for Salmonella and Shigella, so a positive culture after repeated antibiotics points to Salmonella; Giardia and C. difficile are not detected on this medium.

Q5467.reason: Speeding that kills without malice is most plausibly involuntary manslaughter, since the victim's earlier fall is unlikely to break causation and speeding alone does not show malice for murder.
